newsitem.title: UK: BBC to distribute business programme worldwide.
newsitem.headline: BBC to distribute business programme worldwide.

text.p: BBC Worldwide Learning on Monday said it will launch ts business programme, 20 Steps to Better Management - The Drama, to international television markets with the programme's introduction at the Mipcomm '96 television trade show in Cannes.

BBC Worldwide Learning, which is part of the BBC's commercial arm BBC Worldwide Ltd, co-produced the international version of 20 Steps to Better Management with the BBC's Learning Zone. BBC Worldwide secured all international distribution rights to the programme in exchange for its investment.
The international version, which is currently in production, is based on the original 15-minute, UK version, which gives practical guidance on all aspects of managing people.
The international version chronicles the efforts of four senior managers at a ficticious software firm who are vying for the newly vacant managing director's position.
